author: dax_
quote: GTA 6 is like that one fun scumbag friend you had, that gave 0 **** about anything and just does whatever they want that you knew since childhood, that disappears for a decade and resurfaces as a reborn touchy crystal person... It feels like a game made by people who HEARD of GTA, but decided to leave out the parts they didn't like or consider appropiate. loved this franchise so much, and tbh i didn't have high hopes, although after RDR2 i still kept my faith, i was waiting to be just a generic dumb mean spirited game with satire humor, but nothing prepared me for this (hate the term but it's the one that comes closer to the idea) "woke" sandbox with the most boring characters and story, i could not care less nor give a single **** about any of it, which just leaves you with a mindless sandbox filled with stupid mini games.
